facts.business: India Finsec Limited operates as an unregistered Core Investment Company (CIC) following the surrender of its NBFC-ICC registration on July 17, 2025, with its subsidiary IFL Finance Limited operating as an NBFC-ICC.

auditor.name: M/S. Ajay Rattan & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on surrender of NBFC-ICC Certificate of Registration and conversion to unregistered Core Investment Company (CIC) effective July 17, 2025; financial statements prepared under Division II of Schedule III instead of Division III for NBFCs.
